This juxtaposition creates a sense of tension and resolution, highlighting the idea that fortune and positivity can emerge even in unexpected, perhaps even unfavorable, circumstances.

The haiku also explores the theme of perception and perspective. The speaker's attention to the Lichun's light amidst the rain implies a mindful and optimistic outlook, one that seeks out the good even in mundane or trying conditions. The haiku's use of imagery and suggestion rather than direct statement adds to its enigmatic and contemplative nature.
